rules.statement: A Magistrate's Court should not be turned into a forum for the settlement of civil disputes, yet, a Magistrate making an order under Section 431 must exercise his judicial discretion in ascertaining the person entitled to possession.
rules.supporting_quote: A Magistrate's Court should not be turned into a forum for the settlement of civil disputes, yet, a Magistrate making an order under Section 431 must exercise his judicial discretion in ascertaining the person entitled to possession.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 431 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979
